description: Explain what an Obelisk Rating number means: its trust band, how the public scan scores, and what typically moves a score. Deterministic by default; pass narrate:true for an additional one-line model-written narrative (cached, public-scope, never required). Pure function of the number — no data is read.

narrate.description: S283 — also return `narrative`, a one-sentence model-written reading of the band (deterministic fields are always present).

rating.description: A 0-100 Obelisk Rating, e.g. from scan_trust or get_org_rating.

name: explain_rating
